name: Medical Facials
intro: A considered, clinical alternative to spa-style facials, chosen for skin quality support between your other procedures.
statement: A considered, *clinical alternative to spa-style facials,* chosen for skin quality support between other procedures.
sessions: As often as suits your skin

tiers.title: Enzyme Facial
tiers.text: A gentle enzymatic exfoliation that resurfaces without abrasion, suited to sensitive or reactive skin.

tiers.title: Signature Facial
tiers.text: Our considered, all-round facial: cleansing, exfoliation and hydration tailored at the time of treatment.

tiers.title: Fire and Ice Facial
tiers.text: A warming and cooling dual-phase facial that calms while it resurfaces, for an immediate, visible result.

suits: Most skin types looking for a lower-downtime option, often as part of an ongoing plan.
notSuitable: Active skin infection, certain sensitivities, or recent more intensive treatment in the same area.
assessed: Skin condition and any recent treatments are reviewed to confirm suitability.
before: Skin is cleansed and assessed before treatment begins.
during: Your practitioner applies the treatment, adjusting pressure and product to your skin's response.
after: Skin may appear slightly flushed immediately afterwards, settling within a few hours.
risks: This treatment carries minimal risk; mild sensitivity or temporary redness is possible.
